# llms.txt — Philip Sun

## About

Philip Sun is a product manager, healthcare founder, photographer, and B2B ecommerce entrepreneur based in Provo, Utah. He is currently a student at Brigham Young University — Marriott School of Business (3.96 GPA, graduating April 2026).

## Identity

- **Product Manager**: PM intern experience at Nursa (AI-powered credentialing) and The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints (Microsoft Teams Phone migration, 1,200+ phones). Change management lead for BYU's Workday implementation (35,000+ users).
- **Founder & CEO**: Founder of Inara Health Diagnostic, a medical device startup developing a continuous progesterone monitoring device for early pregnancy care. Deployed $40K in capital toward R&D.
- **Photographer**: Runs a photography business offering portrait, event, and commercial photography. Clients can view packages and book sessions at philipsun.com.
- **Ecommerce Entrepreneur**: Sources and distributes commercial water filtration systems (Puno Filter) and smart home technology (Smart Sync) globally through B2B wholesale channels.

## Key Topics

- Product management (roadmapping, user research, data analysis, Agile/Scrum)
- Healthcare and medtech founding (medical devices, clinical outreach, biosensing)
- Photography business (portrait, event, commercial; package pricing; booking)
- B2B ecommerce and global wholesale (commercial filtration, smart home, China sourcing)
- Business strategy and entrepreneurship (BYU Marriott School)
